PDF CPU Ray Tracing of Tree‐Based Adaptive Mesh Refinement Data
Abstract Adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) techniques allow for representing a simulation's computation domain in an adaptive fashion. Although these techniques have found widespread adoption in high-performance computing simulations, visualizing their data output interactively and without cracks or artifacts remains challenging.
